# WDYT authenticated MCP tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-wdyt-mcp-reference.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Connect to `https://www.wdyt.page/mcp` with OAuth. The consent flow selects the user and
workspace; tools never accept an organization ID as input. Public link pages can still use
the HTTP workflow documented at `https://www.wdyt.page/agent.md`.

## Discover and read

### `wdyt_list_pages`

List pages available to the authenticated person in the OAuth-selected workspace.

Inputs: none. Traits: read-only.

### `wdyt_get_page`

Get page metadata, versions, comments, drawings, and access facts.

Inputs: `pageKey`. Traits: read-only.

### `wdyt_get_context`

Get the agent-ready Markdown review context for a page version.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `version`. Traits: read-only.

### `wdyt_get_current_html`

Get clean source HTML with saved editable-field values applied.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `version`. Traits: read-only.

### `wdyt_get_reviewed_html`

Get an annotated HTML snapshot for visual inspection. Never upload this snapshot as a new version.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `version`. Traits: read-only.

### `wdyt_list_collaborators`

List collaborators and pending invitations. Only the page owner can inspect access membership.

Inputs: `pageKey`. Traits: read-only.

## Create and revise

### `wdyt_create_page`

Create a page owned by the authenticated person in the OAuth-selected workspace.

Inputs: `html`, `title`, `label`. Traits: mutating.

### `wdyt_upload_version`

Upload a complete replacement HTML version to an existing page.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `html`, `label`, `baseVersionId`. Traits: mutating.

### `wdyt_update_page_name`

Rename a page without changing its stable URL.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `name`. Traits: mutating, idempotent.

### `wdyt_update_field_state`

Persist bounded scalar values for data-wdyt-field elements.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `versionId`, `changes`. Traits: mutating.

## Collaborate

### `wdyt_add_comment`

Add a precise comment to a page version.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `versionId`, `body`, `x`, `y`. Traits: mutating.

### `wdyt_reply_to_comment`

Reply to an existing WDYT comment thread.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `versionId`, `parentCommentId`, `body`. Traits: mutating.

### `wdyt_update_comment`

Replace the body of an existing comment.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `commentId`, `body`. Traits: mutating, idempotent.

### `wdyt_delete_comment`

Delete a comment and its replies.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `commentId`. Traits: mutating, destructive, idempotent.

### `wdyt_add_drawing`

Add a freehand drawing to a page version.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `versionId`, `points`, `color`, `width`. Traits: mutating.

### `wdyt_delete_drawing`

Delete a drawing from a page.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `drawingId`. Traits: mutating, destructive, idempotent.

### `wdyt_mark_ready`

Tell the human that an agent version is ready for review.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `versionId`, `note`. Traits: mutating.

### `wdyt_wait_for_review`

Wait briefly for a new review-ready signal, comment, or version.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `afterVersionCount`, `afterCommentCount`, `afterSignalCount`, `timeoutSeconds`. Traits: read-only.

## Access

### `wdyt_set_visibility`

Set link, workspace, or private visibility. Protected modes require WDYT Pro.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `visibility`. Traits: mutating, idempotent.

### `wdyt_invite_collaborator`

Create a seven-day private-page invitation for a verified email.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `email`. Traits: mutating.

### `wdyt_revoke_invitation`

Revoke an unused private-page invitation.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `invitationId`. Traits: mutating, destructive, idempotent.

### `wdyt_remove_collaborator`

Remove a user's explicit access to a private page.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `userId`. Traits: mutating, destructive, idempotent.

## Lifecycle

### `wdyt_archive_page`

Archive a page immediately while retaining it for the configured archive window.

Inputs: `pageKey`. Traits: mutating, destructive, idempotent.

### `wdyt_restore_page`

Restore an archived page. Extended retention entitlement is required.

Inputs: `pageKey`. Traits: mutating, idempotent.

### `wdyt_delete_page`

Permanently delete the explicitly named page and all versions, comments, drawings, invitations, and field state.

Inputs: `pageKey`, `pageName`. Traits: mutating, destructive, idempotent.

## Safety

- OAuth tokens are transport credentials. Never put them in tool arguments, artifacts, logs, or chat.
- The selected workspace comes from Clerk's verified OAuth context.
- `wdyt_delete_page` is the only permanent-deletion tool and requires both page key and exact page name.
- Prefer archive over permanent deletion unless the human explicitly asks to erase the page.
